subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI for this session-routing fix?
rationale: The code path is user-visible channel delivery, and the PR itself says live Telegram/Mantis proof is pending, so automation should not treat source-only proof as sufficient without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the remaining risk that real transport delivery still misroutes or drops the completion.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want to fold the fix into the broader Telegram detached-subagent liveness and terminal-delivery contract tracked elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Require Live Owner-Session Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest current-main owner across the touched heartbeat, task delivery, and subagent completion paths.
